participant_budget: Nine fixed people each supply four presentations of the same photograph. Both experiments use exactly the fixed-word cohort and the original 128 generic objects.
question: Can a direct EEG estimate improve the same 24-coordinate normalized foreground outline for which a single legal support oracle beat the eight-support medoid? The prior DINO-selector result on the 32 validation objects was known before this follow-up.
split: Retain the previously frozen 96 fitting objects and 32 development evaluation objects. Use one fixed four-way cross-fit of the 96 objects for shrinkage: RNG seed 260555 permutes their sorted IDs, divide into four 24-object test groups. At each fit all ten photographs of a class are excluded together. Eligible support images are the other eight photographs in five leave-two-out folds.
features: Each person's original 1003 posterior EEG features and ordinary within-class ridge with penalty 2.0 predict the measured 24 normalized log radii directly. Use exactly the previous model, threshold, angular bins, smoothing and contour distance. Separately for each person subtract the pointwise median of the eight support EEG predictions from the query prediction. Average the nine residuals in native log-radius units. Subtract the mean over angles to remove overall scale.
shrinkage: Use the 960 out-of-fold predictions, training classes only. The class prior is the coordinate-wise support median recentered over angle. Choose one nonnegative slope in [0,1] that minimizes total absolute error of prior plus slope*EEG residual against the true training silhouette, using the weighted median of target residual / predicted residual. Train the last nine ridge maps on all 96 objects with that frozen slope.
primary: Direct continuous prior plus the calibrated residual. Matched must beat the support median and the same-word/fold exchanged continuous prediction in mean absolute log-radius error, with both lower endpoints of two-sided paired 95 percent whole-class bootstrap intervals positive. Use 10000 samples of the same 32 classes, seed 260554. Also report original medoid and nearest legal template under matched or exchanged prediction, and the legal target-shape oracle. Intervals are conditional on this previously explored split.
image_stage: Only after passing, fit the maps on all 128 external generic objects, keeping the slope frozen. Start every arm for a query from the same verified cohort-9 four-step uniform JPEG, predicted word and recipient seed for the two existing 120-photo panels. Estimate the recipient-specific support median plus matched EEG or original same-word/fold exchanged EEG. Edit only the generated JPEG, with a common strength of 0.35 and smooth border-preserving radial resampling, center and projected axis scale fixed. Compare neutral, support median, matched and exchanged using remeasured U2NetP contours, DINO CLS within ten and other quantitative image metrics. No true query shape or pixels can be used for generation. A failed generic gate stops the image stage.
